title: Destructive/reset actions: scope and confirmation
cluster_summary: Every finding is a local UX or reset-path gap in one addon, and no LibKa0s seam would make any of them moot, so each fix lands in its own repo. PanelMaster carries the real work. Its delete-all popup says 'on this character', but the AceDB profile is the shared 'Default', so the text understates the reach to every character on a default install. Its global reset skips the session-only rows that options-ui-§12 requires it to sweep, and the tests are too thin to catch that. Its per-panel Delete and Reset have no confirmation, and a Registry comment wrongly says Reset is confirmed. Recommendation: fix PM-R-02 now; do PM-A-01 and PM-A-02 together, test first; fix the PM-R-05 comment and add a confirmation for per-panel Delete. PrettyChat's Categories Defaults is already documented and is the owner's call.

verdicts.assessment: Verified: settings/Slash.lua:81 says 'on this character' and core/Database.lua:19 passes true to AceDB:New, which selects the shared 'Default' profile. Accepting the popup therefore deletes the layouts of every character on that profile, and this popup is the player's only warning. The fix is a one-line string change.
verdicts.remediation: Reword KA0S_PANELMASTER_DELETEALL so it names the active profile (format with db:GetCurrentProfile(), set in OnShow or through the text_arg1 argument of StaticPopup_Show) and says the profile is shared by every character using it. Add a test asserting that the text contains the profile name and does not contain 'this character'.

verdicts.assessment: Verified: Sl:DoResetAll (settings/Slash.lua:36-47) only brackets db:ResetProfile(), so the sessionOnly rows settings.locked and debugConsole survive a reset. That breaches a real options-ui-§12 MUST, and the in-code comment defends the omission, which the rule forbids. The impact is moderate rather than data loss, because /reload or the Lock checkbox clears it.
verdicts.remediation: After db:ResetProfile(), inside the bulk bracket, restore each sessionOnly row to its default: re-lock through NS.Unlock:SetUnlocked(false) with combat deferral, and hide the console through NS.DebugLog:Hide (or NS.SchemaRuntime.ApplyDefault for each row). Rewrite the settings/OptionsSetup.lua:285-294 comment to describe the sweep. Land it test-first with PM-A-02.

verdicts.assessment: The reset tests (tests/test_slash.lua:378-409) create one panel and never check the second profile, the session-only rows or the PanelsChanged publish. That is why PM-A-01 shipped green. options-ui-§12 Testing MUST requires this proof, and it costs one case.
verdicts.remediation: Add one case, written first and red before PM-A-01: three panels, a second profile, unlock, console shown, then accept RESETALL. Assert zero panels, the profile list and the current profile unchanged, state.locked true, the console hidden and exactly one PanelsChanged. Add the red-under note.

verdicts.assessment: Verified: per-panel Reset and Delete call Registry directly with no popup, and the modules/Registry.lua:945-946 comment says Reset 'is confirmed on its own control', which is false. The false safety claim is a trivial must-fix. A confirmation on Delete is justified because a misclick on an irreversible control loses a panel's configuration. The standard does not mandate either confirmation.
verdicts.remediation: Always correct the Registry.lua:945-946 comment. Add a StaticPopup confirmation naming the panel for per-panel Delete (KA0S_PANELMASTER_DELETE), and preferably one for per-panel Reset too, which makes the comment true. Update tests so they assert the popup and then OnAccept.

verdicts.assessment: The facts hold: settings/Panel.lua:756-758 resets every category tab with no popup. The behavior is disclosed in README.md:63/:65 and in the tooltip, and no standard requires a confirmation here. A confirmation inside defaultsOnClick would also make the Blizzard footer Defaults path, which Blizzard already confirms, ask twice. This is an elective UX choice.
verdicts.remediation: Owner's call. If done, gate only the header Defaults button's click path with a new StaticPopup PRETTYCHAT_RESET_CATEGORIES and a new locale key, not defaultsOnClick, so the footer path does not ask twice. Update tests/test_panel.lua:384 and the README.md:65 wording. Otherwise leave it as documented.
